prompt_meta.title: Foundation Hardening: close STEP-0001 notes (Docker infra verification + Mobile test runner fix) + naming consistency + CI alignment

owner_actions.instruction: Start Docker Desktop / Docker daemon on your machine (required to validate infra).

step_objectives.goal: Make foundation truly green: infra verified, mobile tests pass in monorepo, CI aligned, and branding consistent as 놀이짝 (NoriJjak).
outcomes: Mobile unit tests pass reliably in monorepo + CI
Root scripts / CI can run api+web+mobile tests without manual tweaks
Branding consistency: user-facing name is 놀이짝 (NoriJjak) everywhere it appears
constraints: Do not implement new app features beyond what already exists (no auth, booking, payments, chat).
IDE is free to choose the best mobile test approach (Jest/Vitest/etc.) as long as it runs in CI and passes.
If any renaming affects internals (package names), IDE may choose whether to change them; user-facing branding must be correct regardless.
definition_of_done: Docker compose for infra starts successfully OR a clear documented reason why it cannot on this machine (with fix steps).
Mobile test suite passes (at least 1 meaningful test for locale persistence/i18n switching) and runs from repo root.
CI workflow updated (if needed) so it reflects the new green test commands.
ops/manifest.json updated: STEP-0002 COMPLETED and STEP-0001 notes/status clarified (see tasks).

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Prove infra config is correct and runnable locally.
requirements: Run docker compose for infra successfully.
Add or update infra/README.md with exact start/stop/verify steps and known pitfalls.
Add a simple verification instruction (e.g., how to confirm postgres/redis are reachable) in docs.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d succeeds with Docker running
Evidence of verification is captured in report (command output/log tail)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Remove the RN 0.76 test runner blockage and make tests reliable.
requirements: Choose and configure a mobile test strategy that works in a pnpm workspace monorepo.
Ensure at least one automated test validates language toggle persistence and/or i18n switching logic.
Ensure tests run headlessly (CI-friendly) without requiring a simulator.
acceptance_criteria: Repo-root test command includes mobile tests and passes
CI job runs the same commands (or clearly documented equivalent) and would pass

deliverables_outcomes.goal: One obvious way to run quality gates across apps.
requirements: Ensure root scripts exist and are correct: lint, test, build (dev unchanged unless needed).
Ensure CI workflow runs the same gates that we expect developers to run.
acceptance_criteria: Root lint/test/build commands succeed (or are clearly split but runnable from root)
CI workflow uses those commands (or documents why it cannot)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Make the product name correct wherever it is shown to users/readers.
requirements: Update any user-facing strings in web/mobile/README/docs that still reference the old name (e.g., PlayOn/플레이온) to 놀이짝 / NoriJjak.
Do not over-rotate on internal package naming unless necessary; prioritize user-facing correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Web and Mobile display app name as 놀이짝 (KO) / NoriJjak (EN) via localization
Docs show 놀이짝 / NoriJjak as the project name

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Make ops/manifest.json truthfully reflect reality and track completed notes.
requirements: Add STEP-0002 entry as IN_PROGRESS at start and COMPLETED at end.
Clarify STEP-0001 status to match reality: either keep COMPLETED with explicit notes of what was missing, OR change to COMPLETED_WITH_NOTES (preferred) and record the notes.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest shows STEP-0001 notes resolved by STEP-0002
Manifest shows STEP-0002 completed with timestamps in Asia/Seoul

tasks.name: Verify infra with Docker running
tasks.objective: Bring up infra services and capture evidence.
constraints: Do not change infra scope beyond what’s needed for reliability

tasks.name: Make mobile tests pass in monorepo
tasks.objective: Fix the RN test runner issue and ensure stable CI-friendly execution.
constraints: IDE chooses approach; must document decisions

tasks.name: Align root scripts + CI
tasks.objective: Ensure root lint/test/build cover api+web+mobile and CI runs them.

tasks.name: Update user-facing branding to 놀이짝 (NoriJjak)
tasks.objective: Ensure user-facing name is consistent in UI and docs.
constraints: Internal naming can remain if not user-facing
acceptance: no user-facing old name remains (best effort)

tasks.name: Fix manifest accuracy
tasks.objective: Reflect STEP-0001 truth and close notes via STEP-0002 completion.
constraints: Manifest is the source of truth

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Choose the implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0002.report.json with no placeholders.
